arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
# measure peak RSS of the worst-case run
import json, resource, subprocess, sys, os, time
doc = json.load(open('perf_input.json'))
print("input packets:", len(doc["packets"]), "window", doc["config"]["window"], "classes", doc["model"]["classes"])
t0 = time.time()
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    with open('perf_input.json','rb') as f, open('/dev/null','wb') as devnull:
        os.dup2(f.fileno(), 0); os.dup2(devnull.fileno(), 1)
    os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'])
else:
    os.waitpid(pid, 0)
    ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print("peak RSS: %.1f MiB, wall %.2fs" % (ru.ru_maxrss/1024.0, time.time()-t0))
PYEOF
